overall: The AG found the Cotuit Fire District Prudential Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by convening in Purpose 3 executive session for an improper purpose on September 27, and ordered compliance and release of the session minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the commission met in executive session on September 27 under Purpose 3 (collective bargaining/litigation strategy) for an improper purpose.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by convening in executive session for an improper purpose on September 27 as it failed to provide information that would lead this office to conclude otherwise.

allegations.summary: The commission did not produce executive session minutes or further explanation of the session's discussions despite repeated AG requests during the investigation.
allegations.key_passage: We caution the Commission that we may find a violation of the Open Meeting Law for a future failure to respond to our request for information and/or materials in the course of an investigation.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Release the executive session minutes of the September 27 meeting within 30 days of receipt of the letter.
remedy_passage: In addition, we order the Commission to release the executive session minutes of the September 27 meeting within 30 days of the Commission's receipt of this letter.
